dedupe_keys.name: input data and results of the recc v2 5 model for the transformation scenarios of the global building stock

description: A University of Freiburg researcher publishes the input database and core results for RECC version 2.5 global-building-stock scenarios. Zenodo provides one archive under CC BY 4.0. The description lists 120 model parameters, eight sensitivity parameters, seventy result folders, classifications, configuration workbooks and scenario summaries across ten regions. These files can benchmark long-term building demand, material use and emissions in infrastructure-transformation simulations. The RECC model itself is documented separately; this deposit is the scenario input and output package. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this versioned release. Coverage is the modelled global building stock and its selected scenarios, not directly observed future development. A limitation is that sensitivity-analysis result folders are omitted from this archive, although the publisher says they can be regenerated with the model. Running the model depends on a separate code release and assumptions. No ZIP was downloaded or scenario result reproduced.
